profile.name: 持久化对象
profile.description: 这是一个软件持久化数据模型组件，不是物理实验仪器。它用于实验室软件中保存结构化对象、属性、子项及对象关系，并支持字典读写、UUID 引用、外部数据存取和延迟写入，适合实验数据模型、分析结果和元数据的长期保存。
profile.description_en: This is a software persistence model component rather than a physical laboratory instrument. It is used in laboratory software to store structured objects, properties, child items, and object relationships, with support for dictionary serialization, UUID references, external data access, and delayed writing. It is suitable for long-term storage of experiment data models, analysis results, and metadata.
